description: Macro live-action view of a graphite pencil gently beginning a line at its existing contact point.
camera: Completely locked camera. Preserve input framing. No zoom or drift.
environment: Flat paper on plain ivory desk.
elements: Preserve all existing faint feather outlines exactly. Keep paper, hand anatomy and grip unchanged.

ending: Hold point resting on the same line.
